Flow: Client orchestrator pages delegating CV editing and live preview to `components/features/cv-studio/*` and salary percentile visualizations to `components/features/salary-benchmark/*`.

## Rules
1. **Query-Driven Salary Fetching:** `salary-benchmark/page.tsx` fetches benchmark percentiles via `@tanstack/react-query` (`useQuery` keyed by `[techStack, level, location]`). Never call `apiClient` inside `useEffect`.
2. **Print & A4 Layout Integrity:** `cv-studio-preview.tsx` must preserve clean typography and spacing across both standard and compact density modes.

## Known Traps
- **Fallback Salary Data:** Keep deterministic fallback values for initial render hydration while ensuring live API responses from `/v1/catalogs/salary-benchmark` override defaults.
